'''{{PAGENAME}}''' was a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Our partnership has been quite fruitful lately, it's great -- and I want to trust you more. After all, reliable people are valuable. It's time I let you in on a delicate operation I'm running at the resort. However, first, I would like you to prove your loyalty to me, bring me an ear necklace. Haha! Just kidding about the ears, but seriously. If you want in on this operation you'll need to prove your loyalty to me, but not necessarily with blood, if you know what I mean.}}

== Requirements== 
* Must be level 12 to start this quest.

==Objectives==
* Hand over 8,000 [[Dollars|USD]] to [[Peacekeeper]]

==Rewards==
* +9,500 [[EXP]]
*[[Peacekeeper]] Rep <font color="green">'''+0.04'''</font>
{{quote|As I thought, you are a man of business. Now I know that I can count on you not only in assignments but also in financial help, he-he.}}
